entities.name: Iwset-Jehesic War
entities.description: War in the Dark Age on Terisiare between Iwset and Jehesic.

entities.name: Peemel
entities.description: Ambitious lord of Iwset, assassinated by Digody.

entities.name: Edara
entities.description: Lady of Jehesic who refused Peemel.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: Blood witch sent to sow discord.

entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Edara's secret lover and Peemel's advisor.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Peemel's son who refused the throne.

entities.name: Offero
entities.description: Inquisitor scheming to depose Edara and Apepei.

events.summary: Peemel proposes war on Jehesic after Edara refuses his hand.
events.quote: he proposed war upon the island state of Jehesic when its lady Edara refused his hand in marriage

events.summary: Sacumon tricks the Niroso into attacking the elves and minotaurs.
Apepei kills Ferantia as she tries magical coercion on Edara.
events.quote: Edara's secret lover and Peemel's other advisor Apepei , killed Ferantia

events.summary: Jehesic kidnaps Ihesia and sinks Iwset's navy.
events.quote: Jehesic responded by kidnapping Iwset's general-in-chief Ihesia and sinking Iwset's navy

events.summary: Digody assassinates Peemel after he abducts Edara; Apepei kills Digody.
events.quote: Digody assassinated Peemel before he could put his plans into effect

events.summary: Yunnie refuses the throne, smashing the city's sigil, leaving Edara and Apepei to rule; the war ends.
events.quote: Yunnie refused, smashing the sigil of the city

relations.quote: Apepei then killed Digody in turn
the son of Peemel's deceased wife
